# Brand story: Tidewater Plumbing

## Character

Who they are: a homeowner with water where it should not be, searching on a phone.

What they want (one thing): the leak fixed today at a price they agreed to.

## Problem

Villain (the cause, not a person): open-ended hourly pricing and vague time slots.

External problem (the practical thing): a leak that gets worse every hour.

Internal problem (how it makes them feel): dread of the bill and of losing a day waiting.

Philosophical problem (why it is wrong that this happens): nobody should have to say yes to a repair before they know what it costs.

## Guide

Empathy (we understand): "You should know the price before anyone touches a pipe."

Authority (we can help, proof from 04-proof.md only): 4.8 from 212 reviews, 92 percent of jobs finished in one visit.

## Plan

1. Book online in two minutes and get your arrival window by text.
2. Get a fixed price in writing before any work starts.
3. Get it fixed, with 12 months of labor warranty.

## Call to action

Direct CTA: book a same-day visit

Transitional CTA (for people not ready yet, optional): see our fixed prices for common repairs

## Failure

What it costs them to do nothing: water damage to floors and walls, and a bigger bill next week.

## Success

What life looks like after: dry floors, a fair bill, and a plumber they will call again.

## One-liner

Most plumbers tell you the price after the job. Tidewater Plumbing gives you a fixed price before any work starts and fixes most leaks the same day.

## Voice

We sound like: a calm neighbor who knows pipes.

We never sound like: an ad voice-over or a sales script.

Words to use: fixed price, today, in writing, on time

Words to avoid: solutions, experts, trusted, world-class
